asset.name: Toggle
asset.description: The two-state pressable with selected semantics, optional icon and label, tooltip integration, and controlled or uncontrolled operation.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Variant styling is declared as an enumerable recipe so the implementation is checkable against the catalog.
Pointer, touch, keyboard, press, and focus-visible behavior is owned once rather than reimplemented.
Controlled and uncontrolled operation share one contract and one event shape.
